summary: Frontend-only test of UKR Standards hierarchy metadata (non-destructive additive change) on /qiks (InstitutionalKnowledge). Logged in as demo.admin, navigated to Standards Registry, searched 'Knowledge Record'. All THREE target cards render with correct designation badges + inherits_from lines; UKR detail dialog shows Standard Type/Inherits From/Implemented By correctly. All three qiks tabs (standards, graph, memory) load without runtime errors. Test passes.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option> in qiks-category-filter select (InstitutionalKnowledge.js line ~121). Not caused by this iteration but flagged for cleanup — options should only contain text, not span children.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove nested <span> inside <option> in InstitutionalKnowledge.js category filter to fix React hydration warning (pre-existing, cosmetic console warning only).
Review request stated route '/institutional-knowledge' but actual mounted route is '/qiks' (App.js line 183). Update prompts/docs to reference '/qiks' to avoid future confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: Route mismatch between review request ('/institutional-knowledge') and actual App.js route ('/qiks'). Not a bug, but a documentation inconsistency.
test_credentials: demo.admin@qru.com / qru-demo-admin-2026 → POST /api/auth/login returns {access_token, token_type, user}. Token stored in localStorage['qru_token'].

verified_assertions.regression: qiks-tab-standards / qiks-tab-graph / qiks-tab-memory all switch and render without console errors (only pre-existing hydration warning noted above).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Route is /qiks not /institutional-knowledge. Login via POST /api/auth/login (not /api/enterprise/auth/login). Store token in localStorage key 'qru_token'. Standards tab is the default; search input data-testid=qiks-search. Detail dialog uses uppercase label headings (STANDARD TYPE, INHERITS FROM, IMPLEMENTED BY) — case-sensitive matching required.
